activity_sport_matches_kind.name: activity_sport_matches_kind
activity_sport_matches_kind.value:
("activity"."sport_kind" = 'launch' and "activity"."launch_sport" is not null and "activity"."other_sport_name" is null)
        or ("activity"."sport_kind" = 'other' and "activity"."launch_sport" is null and "activity"."other_sport_name" is not null)

consent_owner_withdraw.name: consent_owner_withdraw
consent_owner_withdraw.using: user_id = app_user_id()::uuid and withdrawn_at is null
consent_owner_withdraw.withCheck: user_id = app_user_id()::uuid and withdrawn_at is not null

invite_app_select.name: invite_app_select
invite_app_select.using: redeemed_at is null or redeemed_by = app_user_id()::uuid

profile_sport_matches_kind.name: profile_sport_matches_kind
profile_sport_matches_kind.value:
("profile"."sport_kind" = 'launch' and "profile"."launch_sport" is not null and "profile"."other_sport_name" is null)
        or ("profile"."sport_kind" = 'other' and "profile"."launch_sport" is null and "profile"."other_sport_name" is not null)

profile_training_week_all_or_none.name: profile_training_week_all_or_none
profile_training_week_all_or_none.value:
("profile"."sessions_per_week" is null) = ("profile"."session_minutes" is null)
        and ("profile"."sessions_per_week" is null) = ("profile"."available_days" is null)

screening_owner_doctor_ok.name: screening_owner_doctor_ok
screening_owner_doctor_ok.using: user_id = app_user_id()::uuid and doctor_ok_at is null
screening_owner_doctor_ok.withCheck: user_id = app_user_id()::uuid and doctor_ok_at is not null

screening_doctor_ok_only_general.name: screening_doctor_ok_only_general
screening_doctor_ok_only_general.value: "screening"."doctor_ok_at" is null or "screening"."referral" is not distinct from 'general'

sport_visible.name: sport_visible
sport_visible.using:
status = 'approved'
        or (status = 'draft' and exists (
          select 1 from sport_request r where r.sport_id = sport.id and r.user_id = app_user_id()::uuid))

sport_approved_is_complete.name: sport_approved_is_complete
sport_approved_is_complete.value:
"sport"."status" <> 'approved'
        or ("sport"."profile" is not null and "sport"."sources" is not null
          and "sport"."approved_by" is not null and "sport"."approved_at" is not null)

stop_flag_owner_confirm.name: stop_flag_owner_confirm
stop_flag_owner_confirm.using: user_id = app_user_id()::uuid and confirmed_at is null
stop_flag_owner_confirm.withCheck: user_id = app_user_id()::uuid and confirmed_at is not null
